sub_agendas_items.title: Zero Emission Bus Program Update Report

attachments.attachment_title: English Report - Zero Emission Bus Program Update.pdf
French Report - Zero Emission Bus Program Update.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The following City staff presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Commission.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
There were no public submissions on this item.
Staff accepted the following directions and Commission considered the report recommendation as follows.
Direction to staff (Councillor D. Hill)
That Transit Services staff be directed to provide an update to the Transit Commission in Q1 of 2025 on the work to date to evaluate the feasibility of purchasing additional diesel high-capacity buses to supplement Phase 1 of the Zero Emissions Bus Program.
Direction to staff (Councillor T. Tierney)
Due to the urgent nature, for the 60 foot buses, please provide monthly updates or as soon as any opportunity presents itself to acquire the used fleet as the new buses would be available until Q4 2026 even if we ordered today.

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That Transit Commission receive this report for information.
